citation.title: Neste started producing sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) at its renewables refinery in Rotterdam, the Netherlands
citation.quote: The refinery has been modified to enable Neste to produce up to 500,000 tons of SAF per annum.
also: Neste continues its strategic growth investment project in Rotterdam which will more than double the company’s production capacity at the Rotterdam refinery to 2.7 million tons of renewable products annually
This expansion, scheduled to be completed in 2027

citation.title: Two new gas carriers to stay ahead of environmental standards with Wärtsilä 25 Ammonia engine
citation.quote: Wärtsilä will supply its Wärtsilä 25 Ammonia auxiliary engine, together with a NO x reducer (SCR) and gas valve unit (GVU), for two new 51,350 m 3 capacity midsize LPG/liquid ammonia carrier vessels.
also: The Wärtsilä equipment is scheduled for delivery to the yard commencing in June 2027
